     | **Necessary**    | Implies no viable alternatives; force is the only effective response. | Assumes other options (diplomacy, sanctions, intelligence) fail. |
   - **Contextual Scope**: Applies to social, political, or security domains (e.g., counter-terrorism, gang violence, international conflicts). Not literal physics (nuclear strong force).

     | WWII Allies vs. Nazis | Axis powers posed existential threat; diplomacy failed. Strong force (D-Day, bombings) defeated them. | Victory, prevented genocide escalation.     |
